load_clusters_from_file: load clusters from a .pkl or .npy file and return them as a numpy array
HierarchicalCluster_from_file: build a HierarchicalCluster instance by reading hierarchical cluster files from disk
HierarchicalCluster_from_dict: build a HierarchicalCluster instance from a list of dictionaries with cluster data
HierarchicalCluster_process_clusters: process loaded clusters to compute flat clusters, sizes, and size order per level
HierarchicalCluster_load_clusters_from_f: load cluster data for each level from disk into the HierarchicalCluster instance
